objective: Find whether Claude Code on the web (claude.ai cloud sessions) restricts git pushes to the session's assigned claude/<name> branch, and which setting or environment option lets a session push branches with other names.
scope: Official docs: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/claude-code-on-the-web and related pages (environments, network, GitHub proxy, branch/push permissions), the claude.ai environment settings, anthropics/claude-code issues about branch push restrictions in web sessions
constraints: Primary sources only, cite URL and exact sentence. Say plainly if no restriction or setting is documented. Give the exact UI path or setting name the user changes, if one exists.
Read-only. Keep working until done; stop and report. Report in under 350 words.

criteria.text: push restriction: documented answer on whether pushes are limited to the assigned branch, with sources
setting: the setting that changes it, or a clear statement that none is documented

result:
result: Pushes in web sessions were restricted to `claude/*` branches. The current docs no longer clearly say this for interactive sessions. Routines have a documented per-repo setting. Interactive sessions have no documented setting.

**Push restriction (sourced)**
- Issue #24535 (opened 2026-02-09, https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/24535): "the git proxy restricts pushes to only `claude/*` branches." Pushing to the assigned feature branch returned a 403, and the reporter could push `claude/pr-129-review-fixes-KKnEk`.
- Zenn article (2026-02-17, https://zenn.dev/aromarious/articles/20260217-entire-on-ccweb) paraphrases the then-official docs: the proxy "Restricts git push operations to the current working branch." It shows an HTTP 403 for `entire/checkpoints/v1` and `main`. This is a secondary source; I did not find that sentence in the current official page.
- Official page https://code.claude.com/docs/en/claude-code-on-the-web (fetched 2026-11-03): it says only that GitHub operations "go through the GitHub proxy, which attaches the credential on the server side." I read the first ~40K characters in full. A later fetch (~81 KB) was only grepped for "unrestricted" and "claude/", and the "claude/" hits were not read in context. I found no sentence in the page limiting pushes to a branch. The restriction may have been removed or reworded.
- Issue #91018 (2026-08-31, https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/91018): the web UI picks a branch and shows "Claude will push directly to dev". A commit landed directly on `dev`. So by then, interactive sessions pushed to the selected branch. This is a user report, not official documentation.
- Issue #57356 (https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/57356): pushes updating `main` returned a 403 from the proxy. Anthropic's ashwin-ant commented on 2026-05-14: "This should be fixed now." This suggests the proxy's behavior changed over time.

**Setting**
- Routines (scheduled cloud runs) have a documented option. The docs wording, via the claude-wiki mirror of https://code.claude.com/docs/en/routines (the routines page itself did not return text): "By default, Claude can only push to branches prefixed with `claude/`... enable Allow unrestricted branch pushes for that repository."
- UI path, from a third-party how-to (israynotarray.com, 2026-05-25): claude.ai/code/routines, open the routine, click the pencil icon (Edit routine), find Permissions, check "Allow unrestricted branch pushes" for the repo, save. GitHub branch protection still applies.
- Issue #44949 reports a scheduled task pushed to `main` with that option off. The restriction may not always be enforced.
- Interactive web sessions: no documented setting. The session's selected branch is the one it pushes to. Issue #91018 says no setting can change this.

**Not found:** an official statement of the current rule for interactive sessions, and any environment option that unlocks other branch names.

evidence:
push restriction: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/24535 (claude/* only, 403 on others, Feb 2026), https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/91018 (selected branch pushable, Aug 2026), and https://code.claude.com/docs/en/claude-code-on-the-web (no current restriction sentence found)
setting: Routines only, "Allow unrestricted branch pushes" per repo under Permissions on claude.ai/code/routines; none documented for interactive sessions
sources: the URLs above plus https://zenn.dev/aromarious/articles/20260217-entire-on-ccweb, https://claude-wiki.com/automate-work-with-routines.html, https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/44949, https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/57356

acceptance.rationale: push restriction and setting answered with sources; none documented for interactive sessions
